headlines.title: China’s debt ratio dips as households cut borrowing and firms slash investment: report
headlines.summary:
China’s debt-to-GDP ratio fell in the second quarter for the first time since 2022, even as the government kept borrowing while households and private companies pulled back under the weight of falling home prices, sluggish income growth and shrinking profit margins, according to a new report.

headlines.summary: 哥伦比亚启动了一项旨在积累高达40亿美元国际储备的计划，以促使该国货币从七年高点回落。7月31日，该国央行行长Leonardo Villar宣布了这项决定，就在政策制定者刚刚决定维持利率不变之后。该计划将从8月份初期开始通过每月的看跌期权拍卖进行，首次拍卖的上限为4亿美元。

headlines.title_en: Colombian peso hits seven-year high; central bank to accumulate FX reserves to guide exchange rate lower
headlines.summary_en: Colombia launched a program to accumulate up to $4 billion in international reserves, aiming to pull its currency back from seven-year highs. Central bank Governor Leonardo Villar announced the decision on July 31, just after policymakers held interest rates steady. The program will begin in early August via monthly put option auctions, with an initial auction cap of $400 million.

headlines.summary: 问：美东时间7月31日，美国国土安全部宣布将40余家中国实体增列至“维吾尔强迫劳动预防法”实体清单，请问中方对此有何评论？ 答：我们注意到有关情况。美方相关做法毫无事实依据，持续借所谓“人权”和“强迫劳动”之名，依据国内法肆意对中国企业实施单边制裁，是典型的经济胁迫行为。美方措施严重损害相关企业的合法权益，严重破坏全球产业链供应链稳定。

headlines.title_en: Ministry of Commerce responds to U.S. adding Chinese companies to entity list under so-called Uyghur Act
headlines.summary_en: Q: On July 31 Eastern Time, the US Department of Homeland Security added over 40 Chinese entities to the Uyghur Forced Labor Prevention Act Entity List. What is China's comment? A: We have noted the situation. The US move is groundless, and its continued unilateral sanctions on Chinese companies under the pretext of so-called 'human rights' and 'forced labor' based on domestic law are typical economic coercion. US measures seriously harm the legitimate rights of affected companies and severely disrupt global industrial and supply chain stability.

headlines.title: 53.2万亿元，香港人民币清算量创纪录，离岸市场功能加速升级
headlines.summary: 香港离岸人民币市场正在迎来新变化。数据显示，香港6月人民币清算量升至53.2万亿元，创历史纪录，在港结算规模首次超过港元和美元。此外，香港离岸人民币存款于5月底达到1.13万亿元历史高位，人民币债券发行量年内同比增长33%。多位受访专家认为，清算量、存款和债券发行同步增长，意味着香港离岸人民币市场功能正在从贸易结算进一步向融资、投资和资产配置延伸。人民币国际化也正从“使用场景扩大”，逐步走向“金融功能增强”。（上证报）

headlines.title_en: Hong Kong's RMB clearing volume hits record 53.2 trillion yuan; offshore market functions upgrade pace accelerates
headlines.summary_en: Hong Kong's offshore yuan market is seeing new shifts. Data shows June yuan clearing volume in Hong Kong rose to 53.2 trillion yuan, a record high, with settlement scale in the city exceeding the Hong Kong dollar and US dollar for the first time. Additionally, offshore yuan deposits in Hong Kong hit a record 1.13 trillion yuan by end-May, and yuan bond issuance rose 33% year-on-year. Multiple experts said the simultaneous growth in clearing volume, deposits, and bond issuance means Hong Kong's offshore yuan market function is extending from trade settlement to financing, investment, and asset allocation. RMB internationalization is also moving from 'expanding use scenarios' toward 'enhancing financial functions.' (Shanghai Securities News)

headlines.title: 北京酒类广告明确4项禁令：酒类广告不得出现饮酒动作
headlines.summary: 据北京日报，近日，北京市市场监管局正式印发《北京市食品广告发布指引》（简称《指引》）。《指引》从适用范围、广告发布要求和负面清单3方面对食品广告发布行为进行规范，细化了食品广告的合规标准，压实各方主体责任，为行业划定清晰宣传边界，旨在守护广大消费者的“舌尖安全”。针对酒类广告，《指引》明确了4项特殊规定：不得诱导、怂恿饮酒或者宣传无节制饮酒；不得出现饮酒动作；不得表现驾驶车、船、飞机等活动；不得明示或者暗示饮酒有消除紧张焦虑、增加体力等功效。

headlines.title_en: Beijing issues four bans on alcohol ads: no drinking gestures allowed
headlines.summary_en: According to Beijing Daily, the Beijing Municipal Market Regulation Administration recently issued the 'Beijing Food Advertising Release Guidelines.' The Guidelines regulate food ad publishing across scope of application, advertising requirements, and negative list, detailing compliance standards, tightening responsibility of all parties, and setting clear promotional boundaries, aiming to protect consumers' 'food safety.' For alcohol ads, the Guidelines specify four special rules: no inducing or encouraging drinking or promoting excessive consumption; no drinking actions; no depicting driving vehicles, boats, or planes; and no implying or suggesting alcohol relieves tension or boosts energy.

headlines.title: 2025年地方养老基金投资收益率为5.76%
headlines.summary: 金十数据8月1日讯，全国社会保障基金理事会今天（1日）发布报告，2025年地方养老基金投资收益额1420.71亿元，投资收益率5.76%。自2016年12月受托运营以来，地方养老基金累计投资收益额5544.30亿元，年均投资收益率5.14%，超过年均保底收益率2.63%约2.51个百分点。报告指出，社保基金会坚持并持续丰富“长期投资、价值投资、责任投资”理念，审慎稳健开展投资运营管理，忠实履行好基金安全和保值增值主体责任。

headlines.title_en: Local pension funds' investment return rate in 2025 is 5.76%
headlines.summary_en: Jin Shi Data August 1: The National Council for Social Security Fund released a report today (1st), showing 2025 local pension fund investment returns of 142.071 billion yuan, a 5.76% return rate. Since entrusted operations began in December 2016, cumulative local pension fund returns reached 554.430 billion yuan, with an average annual return of 5.14%, about 2.51 percentage points above the average guaranteed floor of 2.63%. The report noted the Council persists in and enriches its 'long-term, value, and responsible investment' philosophy, conducting prudent and steady investment operations while faithfully fulfilling its primary responsibility for fund safety and value preservation.

headlines.title: 券商收到通知！交易所行情接入，重要调整！影响多大？
headlines.summary: 哥伦比亚启动了一项旨在积累高达40亿美元国际储备的计划，以促使该国货币从七年高点回落。7月31日，该国央行行长Leonardo Villar宣布了这项决定，就在政策制定者刚刚决定维持利率不变之后。该计划将从8月份初期开始通过每月的看跌期权拍卖进行，首次拍卖的上限为4亿美元。

headlines.title: 美国10年期国债收益率创去年1月份以来新高，7月份累涨超25个基点
headlines.summary: 周五（7月31日）纽约尾盘，美国10年期基准国债收益率涨6.15个基点，报4.7347%，本周累计上涨5.76个基点，7月份累计上涨25.56个基点，整体持续震荡上行，交投于4.4534%-4.7450%区间，北京时间8月1日01:47逼近2025年1月14日顶部4.8069%、2023年10月23日顶部5.0187%。 两年期美债收益率涨4.53个基点，报4.2912%，临近结束交易时短线从4.26%附近拉升至4.29%上方，本周累跌3.94个基点、绝大部分时间处于下跌状态，7月份累涨11.68个基点，交投于4.1018%-4.3683%区间。

headlines.title_en: U.S. 10-year Treasury yield hits highest since January last year, up over 25 basis points in July
headlines.summary_en: Friday (July 31) New York close: US 10-year benchmark Treasury yield rose 6.15 bps to 4.7347%, up 5.76 bps on the week and 25.56 bps in July, trading in a 4.4534%-4.7450% range, approaching the January 14, 2025 peak of 4.8069% and October 23, 2023 peak of 5.0187% near 01:47 Beijing time August 1. The 2-year Treasury yield rose 4.53 bps to 4.2912%, briefly jumping from around 4.26% to above 4.29% near the close, down 3.94 bps on the week with most of the time in decline, up 11.68 bps in July, trading in a 4.1018%-4.3683% range.

headlines.title: 邢自强最新研判：两万亿元存量财政托底经济 AI休整不改长趋势
headlines.summary: 【邢自强最新研判：两万亿元存量财政托底经济 AI休整不改长趋势】针对本轮政策周期以及下半年经济、产业和资本市场走向，摩根士丹利中国首席经济学家邢自强给出系统性研判。他认为，本轮政策不会复刻2024年的全面宽松节奏，国内经济将延续典型的K型结构性分化特征。在其研判框架中，下半年稳增长的核心抓手来自可加快使用的两万多亿元财政余力，资金将重点向新基建与硬核科技领域倾斜。

headlines.title_en: Xing Ziqiang's latest view: 2 trillion yuan stock fiscal support underpins economy, AI pause does not alter long-term trend
headlines.summary_en: [Xing Ziqiang's Latest Assessment: Two Trillion Yuan in Existing Fiscal Support Underpins Economy; AI Pause Does Not Alter Long-Term Trend] Morgan Stanley China Chief Economist Xing Ziqiang gave a systematic assessment of the current policy cycle and H2 economic, industrial, and capital market trends. He believes this policy round will not replicate 2024's broad easing pace, and the domestic economy will continue to show typical K-shaped structural divergence. In his framework, the core lever for H2 growth stabilization comes from over two trillion yuan in available fiscal capacity, with funds tilted toward new infrastructure and hardcore tech sectors.

headlines.title: 7月收官8月在望，A股市场风格或走向再平衡
headlines.summary: 从全月表现来看，A股市场整体呈现出“红利占优，科技回调”的格局。申万31个一级行业中，煤炭以14.29%的月涨幅居首，石油石化、银行、食品饮料、美容护理、农林牧渔、交通运输、商贸零售、家用电器、医药生物等行业涨幅居前；前期涨幅较大的电子、通信等科技板块迎来调整。

headlines.title_en: July ends, August approaches; A-share market style may shift toward rebalancing
headlines.summary_en: For the full month, A-shares showed a pattern of 'dividends outperforming, tech pulling back.' Among Shenwan's 31 primary sectors, coal led with a 14.29% monthly gain, followed by oil & petrochemicals, banks, food & beverages, beauty care, agriculture & forestry, transportation, retail, home appliances, and pharmaceuticals; previously strong tech sectors like electronics and communications saw corrections.

headlines.title: 干旱导致缺电，罗马尼亚全国整个8月进入警戒状态
headlines.summary: 当地时间7月31日，罗马尼亚政府宣布，受近期干旱和河流流量下降影响，罗马尼亚发电量下降，在整个8月期间全国进入警戒状态。罗马尼亚国内燃气、燃煤发电厂将以最大产能运行，同时投入光伏、风力发电和储能，并从有过剩产能国家进口电力，以缓解当前局面。（央视新闻）

headlines.title_en: Drought-induced power shortages put Romania on alert for the entire month of August.
headlines.summary_en: On July 31 local time, the Romanian government announced that due to recent drought and falling river flows, power generation has declined, placing the country on alert status for the entire month of August. Domestic gas and coal-fired plants will run at maximum capacity, while solar, wind, and storage are being deployed, and electricity will be imported from countries with surplus capacity to ease the situation. (CCTV News)
